转而想到不能因为这样的罪金主爸爸，不甘不愿的删除微博，毫无诚意的道歉。

紧接着，大理寺卿、鸿胪寺少卿等人，也先后出列，还有礼部、刑部也有人出列。

“皇上‘吉人自有天相’，那几个洋郎中不过是适逢其会罢了。”钟南谦虚地说道。

说来这是人家的地盘，现在张扬可是打败了人家的所有的高手，在台上肯定是不会有掌声了，如果再呆下去，只会拉来仇恨。

除了林婉儿外，严佳佳和王冰冰还有钟研都闭上了眼睛，因为他们不想看到张扬失败的样子，也不想看到他血肉模糊的样子。

“飞沙！”华天使出了天宿决中记载的那门仙法。聚沙形成一道半月形波刃，迎向秦轩的剑芒。

石田伊吹嘴里有些发苦，以旧工厂这里的情况，那个开枪杀人的家伙不免能够在之后发现，后面他们进来的痕迹。

随后，他们扔下了那些手无缚鸡之力的平民，朝着洪莽窜了过来。

秦川身上虽带着雷霆气息，像是曾经历过天劫洗礼，但他们都是上界奇才，战力强横且不说，但眼界绝对是要超出不少，都能看出秦川是因为下界的大道有缺，从而成为禁忌，曾渡过禁忌雷劫。

庄风还以为今天回来之后玛利亚就不会提了那，可没想到人家还是说了。

不等亚人说话，云狼就把发丝发到了镜面上。发丝沉入镜中，犹如一片汪洋。

任强见状，忙伸手绅士般的握着任苏苏的手，入手的感觉非常的丝滑，肉质也很是细嫩，任强就知道，任苏苏平时很注重保护自己的手。

来到叶家大宅院子之中，这里已经人满为患了，并且陆陆续续的有人从外面赶进来。

所以说，任强一旦找到李子奕，他自己会毫不犹豫的离开冯天的公司，去投靠李子奕，不管冯天开出什么样的条件，自己都会毅然决然的拒绝。

Then I thought that because of such a crime, my father, the financial sponsor, reluctantly deleted his Weibo and apologized without sincerity.

Immediately afterwards, the Minister of Dali Temple, the Shaoqing of Honglu Temple and others also came out one after another, as well as people from the Ministry of Rites and the Ministry of Punishment.

"Your Majesty, 'good people have their own destiny.' Those foreigners just happened to meet each other." Zhong Nan said modestly.

It sounds like this is their territory. Now that Zhang Yang has defeated all their masters, there will definitely be no applause on the stage. If he stays here any longer, he will only attract hatred.

Except for Lin Wan'er, Yan Jiajia, Wang Bingbing and Zhong Yan all closed their eyes because they didn't want to see Zhang Yang failed, nor did they want to see his bloody appearance.

"Flying sand!" Hua Tiantian used the immortal method recorded in Tiansu Jue.The gathered sand formed a half-moon shaped wave blade, facing Qin Xuan's sword light.

Ibuki Ishida felt a bit bitter in his mouth. Considering the situation here in the old factory, the guy who shot and killed would inevitably be able to find traces of their entry later.

Then, they abandoned the helpless civilians and rushed toward Hong Mang.

Although Qin Chuan carries the breath of thunder, as if he has experienced the baptism of heavenly tribulation, they are all wizards in the upper realm. Not to mention their powerful combat power, their vision is definitely much beyond that. They can all see that Qin Chuan has become a taboo because of the lack of the avenue in the lower realm, and has survived the forbidden thunder tribulation.

Zhuang Feng thought Maria wouldn't mention it after coming back today, but he didn't expect that she would say it anyway.

Before the demi-human could say anything, Yunlang sent his hair to the mirror.Her hair sank into the mirror like a vast ocean.

Seeing this, Ren Qiang stretched out his hand and held Ren Susu's hand like a gentleman. The feeling was very silky and the meat was very tender. Ren Qiang knew that Ren Susu usually paid great attention to protecting his hands.

Arriving at the courtyard of the Ye family mansion, the place was already overcrowded, and people were coming in one after another from outside.

Therefore, once Ren Qiang finds Li Ziyi, he will leave Feng Tian's company without hesitation and join Li Ziyi. No matter what conditions Feng Tian offers, he will resolutely refuse.
